phase: P2-R5 \u2014 Substrate Closure Beneath Parked P3 (schema authority, live grant binding, backup/restore truth, typed no-work CLI result, truthful evidence)

supersedes.relationship: superseding repair manifest; the original P2 freeze and the P2-R1/P2-R2/P2-R3/P2-R4 repair manifests are preserved unchanged as historical truth; P3 remains PARKED IN PLACE with no P3 capability added during this repair

operator_review_trigger: Operator review of P2 head: schema authority inconsistent (user_version=1 vs runtime schema_version=4 vs historical V3_TO_V4 mutation), historical grant not bound to the current verdict, backup manifest omitted runtime_execution/governance_approval_use, acceptance evidence falsely attributed per-suite, and qcae job run collapsed unknown jobs into nothing-to-do (exit 1)

c01_truthful_evidence_capture.finding: K \u2014 acceptance evidence generator ran qcae/tests/acceptance once and copied aggregate 14/14 into per-file blocks that do not each contain 14 tests; per-window crash booleans hardcoded true; dead crash-harness suspected
c01_truthful_evidence_capture.repair: captured truthful per-file + per-node acceptance counts (operator_loop=5, grant_journey=2, process_crash=7, total=14) with no aggregate relabeling and no hardcoded booleans; no dead crash-harness code existed outside the live P2-R4-A01 acceptance test, so nothing was removed

c02_schema_authority.finding: L \u2014 sqlite_metadata_store.SCHEMA_VERSION=1, open_metadata_db wrote PRAGMA user_version=1, build_local_runtime constructed schema_version=4 and never ran MigrationRunner; runtime could report schema 4 while durable DB reported schema 1
c02_schema_authority.repair: one canonical CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION (=5) used by sqlite_metadata_store, store_factory (runs MigrationRunner on open; migrates 3->4->5, refuses newer/legacy-misversioned DBs), build_local_runtime, and RuntimeIdentity; additive V4_TO_V5 migration (governance_approval_use(step_id) index) with historical migrations immutable

c03_live_grant_binding.finding: M \u2014 _grant_admits(job_id, step_id, principal) consumed an old grant without comparing the current verdict's action/resource/scope/binding against the approved request
c03_live_grant_binding.repair: _grant_admits receives the current StepAuthorityVerdict; live binding digest (principal|action|resource|scope) must equal the approved decision's binding digest before consumption; stale mismatch refuses admission and writes no use row; ApprovalAdmissionProvider port replaces the governance-standalone import in engine.py

c04_resolver_and_guard.finding: duplicate authority-request lookup (engine._latest_authority_request_for_step and runtime_service._latest_authority_request_for_step) and engine.py importing qcae.governance.standalone (architecture violation)
c04_resolver_and_guard.repair: single ApprovalRequestResolver.latest_for_step shared by execution-time admission and grant-release verification; ApprovalAdmissionProvider provider-neutral port; SqliteApprovalRegistry.consume_grant implements the port

c05_backup_restore_truth.finding: N \u2014 backup/restore manifest row-count coverage omitted runtime_execution and governance_approval_use (authority truth: this grant has already been consumed)
c05_backup_restore_truth.repair: added runtime_execution and governance_approval_use to the manifest registry row counts; disaster test A (consumed grant cannot replay after restore) and B (unconsumed grant still eligible exactly once after restore)

c06_typed_no_work.finding: O \u2014 qcae job run on a valid future/not-runnable job returned bare 'no eligible step to run' exit 1, collapsing unknown jobs into nothing-to-do
c06_typed_no_work.repair: typed NoRunnableStep outcome with reasons (FUTURE_NOT_BEFORE, DEPENDENCY_PENDING, WAITING_POLICY, WAITING_INPUT, ACTIVE_LEASE, TERMINAL_JOB, UNKNOWN_JOB), distinct CLI exit code 5, structured JSON; unknown job raises QcaeValidationError (exit 2) so it never masquerades as nothing-to-do

persistence.durability_boundaries: explicit flush() at pre-effect and post-effect semantic boundaries; BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions for multi-row groups; no write transaction spans worker execution
persistence.grant_consumption_table: governance_approval_use(use_id PK, decision_ref UNIQUE, step_id, used_at) \u2014 single-use consumption law, now covered by backup/restore manifest

architecture_guard_evidence.one_authority_request_resolver_shared: ApprovalRequestResolver.latest_for_step used by engine and runtime service
architecture_guard_evidence.oce_absent: runtime reports OCE_ABSENT; no OCE import in qcae/
